PullRequest.Title: Remove unused doc-comments and micro-perf prompts
PullRequest.Body:
Removes the `doc-comments` and `micro-perf` workspace prompts.

Part of #336449

Scenarios.Scenario: Opening the slash-command prompt picker or first resolving a prompt command in the VS Code repository workspace
Scenarios.CriticalPath: On the first cold request, prompt discovery must resolve the configured .github/prompts location, enumerate files, read and parse each discovered prompt, and build slash-command metadata before commands are returned. Warm requests use CachedPromise and only rebuild after file/model/configuration invalidation.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Resolve and enumerate the configured .github/prompts directory through fileService.resolve.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One resolve for the unchanged default prompt source location per discovery pass; directory child cardinality decreases by two.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same directory resolve occurred and returned two additional prompt files.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Required on cold slash-command discovery before the command list is available; bypassed by the warm CachedPromise.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Read each discovered prompt file and parse its frontmatter/content for slash-command metadata.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One read per discovered prompt/skill, bounded to 10 concurrent reads service-wide. The PR removes the reads for doc-comments.prompt.md and micro-perf.prompt.md.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Cold discovery and each invalidated rebuild read and parsed both deleted files in addition to the remaining files.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Cold slash-command discovery awaits all bounded reads; warm cached requests perform none until invalidation.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: The number of discovered prompt and enabled skill files after URI deduplication. This diff lowers prompt cardinality by exactly two files; configured source-folder count is unchanged.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Source locations are resolved by the existing locator flow; discovered prompt/skill reads are queued through the service-wide Limiter with concurrency 10, including overlapping invalidated discovery passes.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Cold discovery enumerates and parses files. The resulting discovery promise is cached; file, model, extension, plugin, or lockdown changes invalidate it. Removing these files neither changes cache keys nor miss/error coalescing and reduces cold parse work.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the deleted files match the default .github/prompts source and the service explicitly enumerates, reads, parses, limits, and caches discovered files.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact repository prompt/skill count and filesystem latency vary, but the direction is unambiguous: two fewer files and no added work.
Scenarios.Verdict: No performance regression. The change removes two entries from an existing bounded and cached filesystem/parse path, slightly reducing cold work.

Scenarios.Scenario: Invoking the removed doc-comments or micro-perf workspace prompt
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Before the PR, command resolution awaited cached slash-command discovery and then read/parsed the selected prompt before handing its instructions to the agent. After the PR, these two commands are absent, so this invocation path no longer exists.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Read and parse the selected prompt file during slash-command resolution.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: At most one selected prompt-file read per invocation after cached command lookup; zero for these deleted prompts after the PR.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Invoking either named prompt caused its file to be read and parsed; deletion removes that boundary call.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Before the PR, the selected file read completed before prompt execution could proceed. The deleted commands now have no execution path.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: A single explicitly selected prompt invocation; any subsequent agent tool/model activity is user- and model-driven rather than automatic per repository item.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Prompt resolution handles the selected command only. Discovery reads remain globally limited to 10; no new parallel tool, subprocess, IPC, or network work is introduced by deletion.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Slash-command metadata discovery is cached, but resolvePromptSlashCommand parses the selected file when present. Deletion removes that selected-file read for these names; it introduces no cache state or retained object.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High that the filesystem read is removed; no evidence of any replacement work or newly retained state exists in the diff.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Downstream agent model/tool operations depended on explicit invocation and model choices, so their duration and cardinality cannot be established statically; no such boundary is newly introduced.
Scenarios.Verdict: No performance regression. This is removal of an optional workflow and its associated per-invocation work, not added or amplified performance cost.

Analysis.Summary: Reviewed both deleted prompt files and traced workspace prompt discovery, caching, bounded reads, parsing, and command resolution. The diff only decreases discovered-file cardinality and removes optional invocation work; it adds no hot-path work, boundary fan-out, allocation, retention, or concurrency.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
